verdict: The render is a faithful reconstruction of the circle, triangle, centre O, altitude AD, line BF through E and H, perpendicular CH with its right-angle mark, and dashed FC and HC. The main discrepancy is a visibly heavier stroke along part of BF.

figure_type.original: Circle with inscribed triangle ABC, altitude AD, centre O, and a line from B through O, E and H to F, with a right-angle mark at H and dashed segments FC and HC.
figure_type.render: Same construction: circle, triangle ABC, altitude AD, centre O, line B-E-H-F, right-angle mark at H, and dashed FC and HC.

issues.description: The segment from E to F appears darker and thicker than the rest of the BF line. The TikZ draws B--F and also B--E--H--F, so the two overlapping strokes double the weight. In the original BF is a single thin line.
issues.suggestion: Draw BF once. Either remove the separate \draw (B) -- (F) and keep the polyline B--E--H--F, or keep B--F and drop E--H--F from the polyline, so the stroke is not doubled.
